verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's hosted MCP server supports OAuth, so an agent can get its own browser-approved, delegated credential instead of a pasted API key. Nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be scoped, restricted to read-only, or limited to specific projects, so least-privilege is unproven. Missing for 10: documented permission scopes or read-only tokens for agents, per-project credential restriction, credential revocation/rotation controls, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Our hosted MCP server supports OAuth, so you can connect an agent by approving access in your browser instead of copying and pasting a credential into a config file.
